text:
Maya: Quick alignment thread for the new landing pages (Hosted / Dedicated / Private). Putting final copy suggestions here so devs can pick them up tomorrow. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/newlaunch/landing-wires
Ben: Proposal: one shared subhead, three distinct hero lines. Drafts: Hosted: 'Ready-to-run LLMs via a lightweight API' ; Dedicated: 'Committed GPU pools for predictable performance' ; Private: 'Inference inside your network, with enterprise controls'.
Ishaan: +1. Hosted hero should have a small benchmark CTA nearby: 'See benchmarks' -> links to blog + gated slides so we capture webinar signups.
Priya: Routing notes: Hosted CTA -> /signup (self-serve). Dedicated -> calendly for capacity scoping (create CRM lead tag: dedicated_capacity). Private -> request demo + security questionnaire. Make the CTAs visually distinct and include secondary 'Talk to sales' on Hosted for larger accounts.
Lena: Copy microcopy suggestions: under Dedicated CTA add one-liner: 'Reserved GPU capacity, SLA-backed.' Under Private hero add: 'SOC2, ISO27001, and VPC-ready.' These are short badges, not full legal copy.
Maya: Can we avoid hard numbers on the hero? Let's use 'cost-optimized tiers' per legal feedback. Show detailed pricing only in modal or pricing page.
Ben: UTM pattern for attribution: ?utm_source=website&utm_campaign=launch_spring&utm_medium=cta&utm_content=<mode>
Ishaan: Webinar: @launch-bot confirm May 12 10am PT webinar and add invite link for benchmark audience. Also create an audience segment 'benchmark_engagers' for people who click slides.
launch-bot: calendar.create_invite: "Serving LLMs at Scale"  May 12 10:00 PT. Hosts: Ishaan, Maya. Link: https://meet.example/webinar
Priya: For lead scoring, add flags: hosted_selfserve, dedicated_capacity, private_security, benchmark_interest. Dedicated CTA should auto-create a CRM task for SolutionsEng to follow up.
Maya: I'll upload the final copy tonight. Copy freeze Tue 5pm PT, dev handoff Wed 9am PT. Please review the Figma by Tue noon.
Ben: I'll patch the CTAs with UTMs and toggle the secondary button for Hosted.
Lena: I'll get cert links and badges ready for the Private page (SOC2/ISO/HSM).
Ishaan: I'll draft the benchmark blurb: short bullets — latency P50/P95, throughput, cost per 1k tokens, methodology link. Keep it tight.
Priya: I'll document the routing->CRM mappings and post the playbook.
Maya: Thanks everyone 680. Let's land this.
